spans.s:
In compound words ending in अञ्च् , the final vowel of the preceding word has the acute accent in the weak cases in which only च् of अञ्च् remains.

Terms: accent-word

The final vowel of the preceding member is lengthened before अञ्च when it assumes the form च having lost its nasal and the vowel.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening
